code.note: the file hashes are authoritative; the commit may predate them

claim.definition: (B5 - B4) / (B5 + B4) from Sentinel-2 Collection 1 Level-2A surface reflectance, B4 averaged to 20 m; the median over clear core pixels within 300 m of the site; a scene counts when at least 80% of those pixels are clear (scene classification 2, 4, 5, 6 or 7).
claim.public_wording: A satellite reading of how green the water looked from space on the date shown: an index that rises with chlorophyll and floating or suspended plant material. It is not a test for harmful algae or toxins, and it is not swimming advice.

season_reasons.no_source_images: Earth Search's sentinel-2-c1-l2a collection, the one the tests read, holds no image over this site from May to September that year (for 2022 at every site; docs/LAKE-ALGAE-SATELLITE-TEST-2026-10.md). The older collection is not mixed in.
season_reasons.no_lab_sample_dates: Images exist, but this site's record keeps only images within a day of an EA lab sample, and none was taken in May-September that year.

release.label: Historical satellite observations, May to September 2020 to 2026, with the date of every image. Not the latest images: no regular refresh runs yet. 1 site also has experimental readings from a one-off refresh after the season.

attribution: Lab chlorophyll: Environment Agency Water Quality Archive, Open Government Licence v3.0

lab_definition.method_note: EA determinand 7887, 'Chlorophyll : Acetone Extract'. Not confirmed as chlorophyll-a; the phaeopigment correction is not stated (docs/LAKE-CHLOROPHYLL-NDCI-TEST-2026-10.md).
lab_definition.censoring: censored '<' means the lab reported below the limit given in value; '>' above it
lab_definition.source: Environment Agency Water Quality Archive, Open Government Licence v3.0

quality.note: Two readings of one lake on one date often differ by a few hundredths and sometimes by much more, so a small change between dates may be measurement variability rather than a change in the water. These figures describe that variability; they are not an uncertainty bound.
